intro: Costa Rica has about 5 million people, known as Ticos.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are of mixed or European descent; Afro-Costa Ricans live on the Caribbean coast, and there are eight Indigenous peoples. Spanish is official. Many Nicaraguans work in Costa Rica.

chapters.title: Long life
text: The Nicoya Peninsula is a 'Blue Zone' where many people live past 100.
